whenToUse: Use designsetgo/icon-button for a call-to-action link or button with an optional icon — primary/secondary CTAs, card actions, hero buttons. It renders as a real link (or button) with hover animation options, and it's DesignSetGo's icon-aware equivalent of core/button.
avoid: Do not set attributes.align to "left" or "right" — the block only supports "wide"/"full" bleed alignment. Use the justification attribute ("left"/"center"/"right") to position the button within its container instead.
Do not leave url empty for a button meant to link somewhere — an icon-button with no url renders but goes nowhere.
Do not pass raw <svg> markup as the icon attribute — icon is a slug (e.g. "rocket", "lightbulb") looked up in DesignSetGo's icon set, not inline markup.
Do not omit text — the visible label is sourced from the text attribute; a button with no text is unusable for sighted and screen-reader users alike.
